biotools.summary: FLAIR2 is a computational workflow that calls isoform models from long-read sequencing data and integrates RNA variant calls with associated isoforms, used to analyze splicing changes and RNA editing. The tool augments existing FLAIR functionality and integrates with long-read sequencing technology.
